name: citymeter-shell
about: Shared code of the CityMETER demos. Navigation (0.1.0): address grammar d/at/e/n with browser history, breadcrumb, tab title. Map (0.2.0): camera presets and the building camera, terrain mode, building x-ray, building join and the CityMETER/OSM building units, vector-tile decoding, planar geometry, the basemap style, the MapLibre 5.6.2 guards and the MapLibre loader. Header (0.3.0): the launch card with one automatic retry, the nav-7 glyphs and help dialog, the dataset picker and the list of demos. Levels (0.4.0): the subdistrict (แขวง/ตำบล) and the local administrative unit (อปท.) in the address and the breadcrumb, for the demos that open them; the locale (ย่าน, 0.4.1). Zones (0.4.2): a zone a dataset defines itself stays a filter that opens a level, its crumb has no production link, and the dataset picker names the place `at` hands over. Networks (0.4.3): a network the reader came through (a rail line, a brand) gets a crumb without a production link, a dataset without a registry code writes no `d`, a link can open the help dialog at one of its sections (data-open-help), a demo can mark its own new-tab links like the shared ones, and every demo is on the shell. Same bytes in every repository that carries it, and so are the files under shared; change them everywhere at once (demo-platform-review, phase 1). Language (0.5.0): one language per page from ?lang= (production style), Thai the source; on a page that declares English (meta citymeter:languages) the page text is replaced in the DOM from dictionaries keyed by the Thai text, names only from the data's own English, Thai dates in the Christian era; the language link and the hub link (“ดูเดโมทั้งหมด”) in the header, the theme control in the list on every width. Words in context (0.5.1): a dictionary entry can depend on its element (a tile label under its number reads “77 provinces”, the filter “Province”), and from an English page the picker marks the demos that are Thai only.
